claims.text: ApexBrasil's mission rules say Web Summit 2025 gathered 71,386 people with access to 869 speakers.
claims.quote: o evento reuniu 71.386 pessoas, que tiveram acesso a 869 palestrantes

claims.text: The rules give 2025 as connections with 2,725 startups and 1,857 investors (the hubs version writes 2.725).
claims.quote: possibilidades de conexões com 2725 startups e 1.857 investidores

claims.text: The European Commission agency HaDEA lists Web Summit 2026 as running from 9 to 12 November 2026 at MEO Arena and FIL, Lisbon.
claims.quote: Where MEO Arena and FIL Rossio dos Olivais, 1990-231 Lisbon, Portugal

claims.text: Startups.com.br reports that, according to Paddy Cosgrave, about 70,000 people are expected at FIL and MEO Arena from 9 to 12 November 2026, about the same as 2025.
claims.quote: devem receber cerca de 70 mil pessoas, segundo Paddy Cosgrave, fundador e CEO do Web Summit

claims.text: Startups.com.br gives Web Summit 2025 as 71,386 participants from 157 countries, 2,725 startups and 1,857 investors.
claims.quote: quando o evento reuniu 71.386 participantes de 157 países, 2.725 startups e 1.857 investidores

claims.text: Startups.com.br says more than 700 founders and executives are on stage this year, across 17 thematic areas.
claims.quote: são mais de 700 fundadores e executivos no palco, em 17 áreas temáticas
